item.doodlepals.sketchbook.tooltip: Right click: draw a creature and bring it to life
item.doodlepals.doodle_page.tooltip: Use it on the ground to wake your pal
doodlepals.too_many: You already have %s pals. Shift + right click one to store it.
doodlepals.no_ink: You need an Ink Sac to bring a drawing to life
doodlepals.sketch.title: Doodle Pals  -  Sketchbook
doodlepals.sketch.name: Name your pal...
doodlepals.sketch.hint: Paint a creature, or press Idea. Colours give powers!
doodlepals.sketch.nopower: No power: cover more of it with one colour.
doodlepals.tool.fill.info: Fill a whole area with the colour.
doodlepals.tool.eyes.info: Place up to 4 eyes on painted pixels. Click an eye to remove it.
doodlepals.tool.idea.info: Load a sample drawing to start from.
doodlepals.power.fire.info: Hits set enemies on fire. The pal cannot burn.
doodlepals.power.tide.info: Breathe and swim fast under water. The pal cannot drown.
doodlepals.power.magic.info: The pal shoots magic bolts from afar.
doodlepals.power.heart.info: Heals you when you are badly hurt.
doodlepals.power.air.info: Slows your falls. The pal is light and quick.
doodlepals.power.shadow.info: Sneak to turn invisible. Hits weaken enemies.
doodlepals.power.rock.info: You take less damage. The pal has more health.
doodlepals.power.iron.info: You mine faster. The pal wears armour.
